sources.citation: StressTyp2 (StressTyp2-v1-archive-0415 SQL dump) and WALS language list, local copies.
sources.note: No StressTyp2 entry for any Aizi language (ahm appears only in the ISO code table); WALS has 'Aizi' (aiz, from Hérault 1971, mapped to apro1235) with no stress features.

sources.citation: OLAC resource listing for ISO 639-3 [ahm] Mobumrin Aizi (Wayback capture 2024-11-17).
sources.note: Lists only Glottolog, Ethnologue, LINGUIST List and the Silué/Boone/Augustin 2002 survey; no language description archived.

sources.citation: Vogler, Pierre. 2024. La classification de l'aizi (Côte d'Ivoire, groupe kru, Niger-Congo). Ms., HAL hal-04627162, 9 pp.; and Vogler, Pierre. 2017/2024. Contribution à la classification des langues kru (Niger-Congo). Ms., HAL hal-04390526 v4, 74 pp. (sec. 3.40-3.43 on Aizi).
sources.note: Nothing on accent/stress. Explicitly restricted to the Tiégba variety ('On se limitera ici au parler de Tiégba'); distinguishes cagba-mr (Tiégba, 5 villages) from mɔbu-mr (2 villages) after Hérault 1971: 98-99.

sources.citation: Boone, Douglas, Silué Lamine & MaryAnne Augustin. 2002. L'utilisation du français et de l'adioukrou par les Aïzi. SIL Electronic Survey Reports 2002-047 (earlier version JWAL 1999).
sources.note: Nothing. Sociolinguistic survey; identifies mobumrin as the Kru-type Aizi language spoken by the Mobuin at Abraco and Abraniamiambo; only a pronunciation note on the language name.

sources.citation: Marchese, Lynell. 1979 [3e éd. 1984]. Atlas linguistique kru: essai de typologie. Abidjan: ILA/ACCT. 446 p. (+ Listes de lexèmes kru, 1983).
